1b1(rgyud): @##//rgya gar skad du/shrI dz+nyA na badzra sa muts+tsha ya/bod skad du/dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa/dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo//'di skad 
1b2(rgyud): bdag gis thos pa yi//dus gcig tshe na bcom ldan 'das//de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi//gsang ba'i dbyings su bdag nyid kyis//ye shes ngo bor bzhugs gyur pas//
1b3(rgyud): sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs//ro mnyam dam tshig rdo rje nyid//mi phyed ting 'dzin snyoms zhugs so//de nas byang chub sems dpa' ni//sems dpa' chen po byams pa 
1b4(rgyud): sogs//rnams kyis zhus shing gsol btab ni//de nas bcom ldan 'das la zhus//ma rig pa dang sems byung dang //sems zhes bgyi ba ji ltar lags//de skad ces ni 
1b5(rgyud): gsol pa dang //bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs kun gyi//sku gsung thugs nyid rdo rje yi//bdag nyid can gyis bka' stsal pa//rigs kyi bu rnams legs nyon cig/ye shes 
2a1(rgyud): @#//gsum ni rdo rje las//byang sems rdo rje de bzhin nyid//yang dag 'byung ba de yi phyir//ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin ni//de yi don ni 'di lta ste//ye shes gsum ni dag pa'i sems snang ba gsum gyi 'byung gnas rdo rje las mi phyed 
2a2(rgyud): pa rlung rig tha mi dad du gnas pa nyid de/byang chub sems ni kun rdzob don dam dbyer med pa ste/rdo rje de bzhin nyid ni gdod ma nas lhun gyis grub pa'i chos nyid las yang dag par 'byung ba ni/chos thams cad kyi ngo bo bde chen/sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs 
2a3(rgyud): rdo rje las 'byung zhing 'jug la gnas pa de'i phyir na/'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ye shes rdo rje rlung sems dbyer med thogs pa med pas khyab cing dbang byed pa nyid do//de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi dgongs pa ni//dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med 
2a4(rgyud): pa nyid//mngon par byang chub nyid las rab 'byung ba//rlung rig dbyer med pa las dus kun tu//snang ba gsum du shar ba 'gag pa med//de nyid lhan cig skyes par rab rtogs bya//yang dag don ni zab pa ste//rdo rje'i ngo bor yang dag bshad kyi don la ni//
2a5(rgyud): gsang ba yang dag byang chub sems//rlung sems dbyer med chos nyid las//zab pa mi 'gyur rang rig ni//spros med 'gag pa med cing zhi//skye med mnyam nyid ngang las ni//rtogs pa med kyang rgyu rkyen las//shes pa ma rig de nyid ni//'byung gnas 
2a6(rgyud): thog ma mtha' ma med//de las lhan skyes ma rig pa//nye bar thob pa dngos med pa//bdag med thams cad snying po las//snang med pa las ma 'gags pas//rim pa ma yin 'char ba yang //zab pa stong chen por 'byung ba'i//ma rig pa las rkyen snang ba//
2b1(rgyud): snang ba thob pa mi rtog pa//de las rang bzhin sems las byung //de las snang ba mched pa ste//shin tu gsal zhing stong pa che//sems las 'byung pa'i rgyan dag ni//rgyu dang mig yul dbang po dang //mtshungs pa'i de ma thag pa las//sems zhes bya ba 'byung ba ste//
2b2(rgyud): de ni snang ba'i don dang ni//stong pa nyid du gsungs pa yin//sems ni don la gnas pa ste//sems byung bye brag rnam par ston//ma rig de nyid chos nyid de//chos nyid bdag nyid mi gnas pas//snang dang stong pa de dag ni//gsum gsum spros pa med 'byung ba//'od 
2b3(rgyud): gsal ngang las 'byung ba ste//gsal ba de stong pa dbyer med pas//rdo rje byang sems ngo bor bstan//ces pas bstan te/de nas byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' de dag de'i dus la shin tu ngo mtshar can du ngo mtshar skyes te cang mi smra bar gyur to//de 
2b4(rgyud): nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid can gyi/byang chub sems dpa' de rnams cang mi smra bar gyur pa gzigs nas bka' stsal pa ci'i phyir cang mi smra bar 'dug/de nas byang chub sems dpa' 
2b5(rgyud): chen po rnams kyis/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal te/mgo bos gtugs te gzhan yang zhus pa/e ma ho ston pa rdo rje 'dzin//rtogs par dka' ba'i rnam shes ni//gsum gyi dbye ba mchog zab pa//bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad 
2b6(rgyud): du gsol//bde bar gshegs pas gsung du gsol//de skad ces ni zhus pa dang //bcom ldan 'das kyis dka' stsal pa//gang dag 'od gsal las byung de nyid ni//sems dang yid dang rnam par shes pa zhes//chos rnams kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa ste//
2b7(rgyud): kun nyon mongs dang rnam par byang ba yi//bdag nyid de las rtogs pa gnyis rig byed//rnam shes de yi bzhon pa rlung yin te//rlung las me dang me las chu 'byung zhing //chu las sa yang rab tu 'byung bar bshad//de rnams 'dus las phung po lnga 
3a1(rgyud): @#//nyid dang //skye mched drug dang yul lngar snang ba gang //de dag rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ste//rlung dang rnam shes nye bar 'dres pa'o//de nas rnam par shes pa gsum gyis ni//rang bzhin gyi ni snang bar rab gsal bar//spyod pa rjes su myong bar 
3a2(rgyud): byed pa'o//snang ba'i rgyu 'bras kyis ni rang bzhin rnams//yang dag par yang rab tu 'byung ba dang //rmi lam sgyu ma ltar ni snang ba'o//de yang 'od gsal gnas pa med pa dang //'gag pa dang ni skye ba med pa ste//don dam bden pa yang dag pa yi mtha'//de las 'byung ba 
3a3(rgyud): mun pa'i snang ba ni//'gog pa ma rig pa zhes bya bar bstan//de yi rang bzhin snang ba dang //'khrul dang rnam par g.yeng ba dang //dran pa med dang le lo dang //mi smra ba dang mi gsal ba'o//ma rig pa yang sems las byung ba ste//ngo bo cho ga nyid rnam par mi rtog pa//
3a4(rgyud): mar me ltar 'bar snang ba nyer thob las//rlung gi khams nyid phra bar 'jug pas ni//ma ning ltar ni shes dang mi gsal ba'o//nyi ma'i snang ba lta bur bstan pa dang //shin tu gsal ba'i smig rgyu lta bu ste//de yi rang bzhin chags dang dga' ba dang //mchog tu dga' 
3a5(rgyud): dang drag po la sogs pa'o//kun rdzob tu ni mngon sum gyis bstan dang //skyes pa'i gzugs dang yab lha'i tshogs dag dang //mtshan ma rdo rje zhes ni rang brtags pa'o//sems las sems zhes bshad pa yin//zla ba'i snang dang shin tu gsal ba ste//chu yi 
3a6(rgyud): zla ba lta bur bstan pa'o//rang bzhin ni 'dod chags dang bral ba la sogs pa'o//kun rdzobs tu gsal ba las/bud med dang /b+ha ga dang /pad+ma dang lha mo'i tshogs kyi brda'o//'dir chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs bstan par bya ba'i phyir/gang dag 'od gsal las byung 
3a7(rgyud): de nyid ni chos nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa 'od gsal dbyings las/rig pa rtog med kyi shes pa phra ba'i rlung dang lhan cig tu 'byung bas na/sems ni kun gzhi'o//yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni spro ba dang sdud par byed pa'o//rnam par shes pa ni tshogs brgyad dang ldan 
3b1(rgyud): pa'o//chos rnams kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa ni/byang chub kyi sems mi 'gyur ba rdo rje nam mkha' mnyam pa nyid do//sa bon ma dag pa las 'gro ba 'khrul pa kun nas nyon mongs par snang la/bag chags dag las 'khrul pa la g.yog pa/rnam par byang ba nyid du yang dag par 
3b2(rgyud): snang ba'o//phyi rol pas brtags pa'i tha snyad sna tshogs pa bdag tu brtags pa de las/rtog pa gnyis su gyur pa ste/gzung 'dzin du 'byung ba'o//bdag dang gzhan ni bdag dang bdag gi bar 'dzin pa gnyis su brtags pas/dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa/
3b3(rgyud): sems su rig par byed pa nyid do//de las rnam par shes pa nyid du snang /de nyid du chos nyid kyi rlung las/'od snang rang byung gi snang bar shar ba'o//der las rlung las kun du g.yo bas/chags pa las me byung /bsrub pa las zhe sdang gi chu snang /drod gsher las gti mug gi 
3b4(rgyud): sa'i khams bskyed cing /der 'byung ba lnga lhan cig tu tshogs shing 'dus pa las/rtsa kun gzhi'i rig pa snying ga tsam du brten te/de las gzung 'dzin du 'khrul pa las/de rnams 'dus pa las phung po lnga dang ni skye mched drug dang yul lngar snang ba ste/de nyid rlung dang rnam 
3b5(rgyud): shes tha dad med par nye bar 'dres pas/'gag pa med pa kun du snang ba rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba nyid du'o//chos nyid rtog med kyi ngang las/rlung dang lhan cig tu 'byung bas/srid pa bar dor yul la spyod tshul ni/de nas rnam par shes pa gsum gyi ni/rkyen las 
3b6(rgyud): 'char ba'i snang ba dang /snang ba mched pa dang /snang ba thob pa ste/rgyu'i rkyen dang /dmigs pa dang /dbang po bdag po dang /mtshungs pa de ma thag pa las/mngon par 'byung ba/rtog pa dang ldan pa'i rang bzhin gyi snang ba/rang bzhin sum cu rtsa gsum dang /mtshan nyid bzhi bcu 
3b7(rgyud): dang ma rig pa'i skad cig ma bdun du rab tu gsal bar nyin dang mtshan du spyod pas/rjes su nyams su myong bar byed pa ma dag pa'i dus so//yang rlung dal zhing rig pa cung zad gnas pa'i tshe/snang ba gsum gyi rgyu 'bras thams cad sgyu ma lta bur gyur pas/rang bzhin rnam pa thams 
4a1(rgyud): @#//cad ye shes kyi ngang du rang dag rang zhi rang sar grol bas/yang dag par rab tu 'byung ba/de bzhin nyid du bde ba/gsal ba/stong zhing bdag med pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'char bas/bag chags rnam par dag pa'i bar dor rmi lam gyi bar dor lus ngag 
4a2(rgyud): sgyu ma ltar kun du snang ba'o//sgyu lus kyi snang ba de nyid kun rdzob kyi spyod pa dag par byed pa'i phyir/de yang 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug pas ril por 'dzin pa dang /rjes su gzhig pa'i bsam gtan gyis lhan cig skyes pa'i dri ma rnam par dag pa'i tshe/gang la yang 
4a3(rgyud): gnas pa med pa dang /chos rnams kun la 'gag pa med pa dang /gnas pa med cing /skye ba med pa ste/spros med don dam pa'i bden pa rab tu mi gnas pa'i don/yang dag pa'i mtha' snang ba med pa zhes bya'o//de nyid las ni lugs las bzlog gyur pa'i//mun pa 
4a4(rgyud): lta bu'i snang ba phra rlung las//'gog pa ma rig pa zhes bya bar bstan//de yi rang bzhin snang ba 'byung ba dang //'khrul dang rnam g.yeng the tshom dang //brjed ngas pa dang le lo dang //mi smra gyur dang skyo gyur pa'o//ma rig pa yang sems las byung ba ste//snang ba nyer thob

4a6(rgyud): snang ba thob pa nyid kyi don 'di'o//snang ba mched pa nyi ma lta bur bstan//shin tu gsal ba smig rgyu lta bu ste//de yi rang bzhin 'dod chags dga' ba dang //mchog tu dga' ba drag po la sogs pa'o//kun rdzob tu ni mngon sum gyis bstan dang //skyes pa'i gzugs dang 
4a7(rgyud): lha yi tshogs dag dang //mtshan ma rdo rje zhes ni rang brtags pa'o//pad+ma de nyid lte bar nyi ma'i dal//dbus su rdo rje theg le ldan pa la//kA li gsal byed yi ge sum cu bdun//snang ba mched pa de nyid gsal ba'o//sems las byung ba la ni sems zhes bshad//zla ba'i snang 
4b1(rgyud): pa rab tu gsal ba ste//chu yi zla ba lta bur bstan pa'o//rang bzhin chags pa dang bral la sogs pa'o//kun rdzob gsal ba las ni bud med dang //b+ha ga pad+ma lha mo'i tshogs kyi brda'o//snga ma ltar las zla dbus pad+mar bcas//dbyangs yig phyogs su brkyang pa 'od 'bar 
4b2(rgyud): ba//mtshams su zung bcas bcu gnyis rim par dgod//gsang sngags 'khor lo rim pa kun rdzogs byed//dmigs bcas bzlas pa sems gsum sgyu mar 'char//'od gsal ye shes ngang las zung 'jug pa'o//snang ba mched pa bde ba ste//gzung du med pas 
4b3(rgyud): chags zhen bral//nyi ma ltar gsal ngang gis bde//'gro 'ong gnas nyid skad cig ma//mtshan ma bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin//go 'byed mun pa 'jom pa'o//snang ba thob pa'i ye shes sems//rnam par mi rtog bdag nyid can//ma rig de nyid rnam dag pa//mun 
4b4(rgyud): pa med cing snang ba bral//sgron me ltar 'char lhun grub pa//g.yo med mi g.yo rnam dag pa'o//gnas med chos nyid ngang du dag/stong dang stong pa chen po dang //shin tu stong pa dngos med pa//thams cad stong pa zag pa med//nye bar thob pa snang med pa//mkha' ltar dag 
4b5(rgyud): pa 'od gsal ba//mnyam med gnyis med phyag rgya che//lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi dbyings//lhag mthong dmigs pa kun las 'das//kun khyab zhi ba spros med pa//stong nyid ngang las rtog pa dang //mi rtog mtha' las 'das pa ste//chos nyid zab dang rgya che ba'i//rgya 
4b6(rgyud): mtsho chen po rang dngos la//rtswa shing g.yo bcas sna tshogs pa//steng du lhung zhing 'gro 'ong nyid//du mas khebs shing bskyod gyur kyang //rtog med rang bzhin gnas med pas//ro gcig 'gyur med mkha' ltar ro//dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las bsdus pa las rab 
4b7(rgyud): tu byed pa dang po'o////rnal 'byor lus nyid sgyu ma rmi lam ltar//gnas lus nges par 'gyur ba de nyid las//rdo rje pad+ma yang dag par sbyor ba shes rab kyi ye shes rab tu 'byung ba las rang gi rdo rje sbyor ba las me'o//me las chu/chu las nur 
5a1(rgyud): @#//nur po rnams dang /de nas mer mer po rnams dang /nar nar po dang /gor gor po dag go//de nas 'dod chags dang bral ba'i snang ba las te/khrag gi gong bu las mkhrang 'gyur rnams so//khyab 'jug rus sbal gyi rnam pa can de dag pha ma'i khu khrag

5a3(rgyud): 'dar ma dang /ro ma dang /brkyang ma dang /lte ba dang /snying ga dang /mgrin pa dang /spyi bo dang /gsang ba dang /mdzod spu'i 'khor lo dag dang /yang na sum cu gnyis dang /rtsa kha gsum pa dang /rtsa lu gu rgyud dang /rtsa ba'i mig lta bu dang /rtsa bar ta ka rin po

5a7(rgyud): bya ba byed 'gyur ba'o//chos rnams kun ni bdag tu bsgrub pa dang //bdag ni lhar bsgrub lha nyid ye shes so//gzugs la sogs pa'i yul dbang po gnyis thabs su gyur pa'o//rdo rje dang pad+ma yang dag par sbyor ba ni/sems dang sems las 'byung ba dag gi 
5b1(rgyud): thabs su gyur pa'o//sems las byung ba mnyam par sbyor ba'i bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis thabs shes rab ro mnyam par gyur pa'o//de sgyu ma lta bu'i dpe nye bar mtshon te/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gang+gA'i bye ma snyed kyi zhing khams rnams/sgyu ma lta bu dang /
5b2(rgyud): chu zla dang /mig yor dang /smig rgyu dang /rmi lam dang /sgra brnyan dang /dri za'i grong khyer dang /mig 'phrul dang /dbang po'i gzhu dang /glog dang /chu bur dang /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis/bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzan nye bar

5b7(rgyud): skom gdung ba po//rig 'dzin yid la byed pa bzhi//rig pa po ste gnas pa las//tshom par byed pa tshor ba ni//rnam pa gsum ste sems pa'o//gnyid dang 'gyod pa rtog dpyod pa//ngo tsha shes dang bag yod pa//rnam par mi 'tshe snying rje dang //brtse ba byams 
6a1(rgyud): @#//pa gsum gsum dang //dogs dang bsags pa ser sna dang //phrag dog rtog pa rang bzhin te//snang ba'i ngang du spro zhing sdud//chags bzhin dang dga' ba dang //dga' zhing shin tu dga' ba ste//'dod chags rtogs par 'byung ba'o//bde

6b1(rgyud): rnam par byung //de yi skad cig rang bzhin 'byung 'jug pa//mtshan ma snang ba gsum du mngon par 'byung //de bas na 'di dag nges par rtogs pas ji ltar 'o ma dang /til dag gis yang dag pa'i mngon par 'du bya ba med pa dang /til mar gyi 'byung ba de bzhin du sngags 
6b2(rgyud): dang phyag rgya mngon par 'du bya ba'i rdo rje dang pad+ma mnyam par sbyor ba med par rnam par shes pa gsum nye bar brtag par mi nus so//gang du rlung med na kun gzhi rten pa med pa'o//gang du kun gzhi'i rten pa med na rnam par shes par mi 'gyur ro//rnam par shes pa nyid 
6b3(rgyud): med na gang blug dang ling+ga yang dag par sbyor bar nus pa med de/des ni bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin mi rnyed do//ji ltar 'o ma bsrubs pa las mar dang /ji ltar til mar te/de bzhin du rdo rje thabs kyi ye shes nye bar brtag pa'i phyir dang /pad+ma shes rab kyi ye shes nye bar 
6b4(rgyud): brtag pa'i phyir ro//yul 'jug pa med cing /de la sems pa med pas/rnam par shes pa'i bzhon pa rlung med do//de med pas phyi rol 'byung ba chen po bzhi dang /nang khams dang skye mched med par 'gyur te/snang ba gsum du dmigs pa yang mi 'byung bas/yang dag pa'i
